title: Evolution families and variation of constants formula for abstract functional differential equations with time-dependent infinite delay
summary: In this paper, we consider a class of first-order abstract retarded functional differential equations in Banach spaces, incorporating a time-dependent infinite delay governed by a regulated function. We establish the existence of mild solutions for the nonlinear equation and show that the family of solution maps for the linear equation forms a well-defined evolution family of bounded linear operators on an appropriate phase space. Furthermore, we leverage this evolution family to prove a variation of constants formula for the inhomogeneous linear problem.
